skill.displayName: Allstar Link node control ASL3 (ASL3 Node Control)
skill.summary: Monitor and control AllStar Link amateur radio nodes via REST API

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of asl-control.

- Monitor and control AllStar Link amateur radio nodes via REST API.
- Provides a Python CLI client for status, connection management, favorites, and timed net sessions.
- Supports environment variable configuration for backend API access.
- Includes natural language command mapping for easy use.
- State files (favorites, net profiles) stored outside the repository for persistence.
- Detailed instructions and usage examples provided in the documentation.
